fields.label: Allow Guest Access
fields.description: When enabled, the /delivery page is accessible without logging in. When disabled, unauthenticated users are redirected to the login page.

fields.label: Source DocType
fields.description: The DocType to search when a QR code is scanned (e.g. Sales Invoice)

fields.label: Match Field
fields.description: Field name in the Source DocType whose value is extracted from the QR (e.g. etr_invoice_number)

fields.label: Prefetch Name Field
fields.description: Optional. Field on the Source DocType whose value is pre-loaded into "Delivered To (Name)" when a document is scanned (e.g. customer_name). Leave blank to disable.

fields.label: QR Value Extraction Method
fields.description: How to extract the matching value from the raw QR code string

fields.label: URL Parameter Name
fields.description: Query-string parameter to read (e.g. invoiceNo extracts 999555 from ?invoiceNo=999555)

fields.label: Regex Pattern
fields.description: Regex with one capture group. The first group match is used (e.g. invoiceNo=(\w+))

fields.label: Send Notification to Client on Delivery
fields.description: When enabled, an email notification is sent to the client contact fetched from the scanned document.

fields.label: Client Email Field
fields.description: Field name on the Source DocType that holds the client's email address (e.g. contact_email)

fields.label: Email Subject
fields.description: Subject line for the client notification email. You may use {doc_name} as a placeholder.

fields.label: Email Message
fields.description: Body of the client notification email. Placeholders: {doc_type}, {doc_name}, {delivered_to_name}, {scanned_at}.
